name: Kindi
biography: The first philosopher to write in Arabic (d. ca. 873) and the only philosopher of note who was himself an Arab; his translation of parts of Plotinus's Enneads under the title 'The Theology of Aristotle' caused lasting confusion between Aristotle and Neoplatonism in Arabic philosophy.
